extraction.name: Prompted Textures Dataset
extraction.description: The Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD) is a collection of 246,285 synthetic texture images across 56 texture classes. It is generated using text-to-image models guided by descriptive prompts and refined through frequency analysis, patch variance filtering, and CLIP scoring to support texture-based tasks and measure texture bias.
extraction.creator: Blaine Hoak (University of Wisconsin-Madison); Patrick McDaniel (University of Wisconsin-Madison)
extraction.citeAs: Blaine Hoak and Patrick McDaniel. On Synthetic Texture Datasets: Challenges, Creation, and Curation. arXiv:2409.10297v3 (2025).
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was generated by constructing texture-specific descriptive prompts and inputting them into the Stable Diffusion text-to-image model to synthesize texture images.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Images flagged as NSFW by the Stable Diffusion safety filter were excluded from the dataset and not released publicly.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data consists of 483,840 texture images generated by the Stable Diffusion model from text prompts, prior to the multi-stage refinement process (frequency, patch variance, and CLIP score filtering).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: 9 participants were recruited to evaluate 100 unique images each. For each image, participants rated the overall quality and how well the image represented the provided descriptor on a scale of 1 to 5.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Mean quality and representativeness scores were calculated across the images at different stages of the refinement process.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: There is room for improvement in generating more structured textures.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset contributes valuable resources for advancing interpretability, bias analysis, and robustness in machine learning. The authors also note their experience highlights the need for refined NSFW filters that can better handle abstract or texture-based content.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Images flagged by the Stable Diffusion NSFW filter were excluded from the final dataset and not released publicly for ethical reasons, although the authors found no images that actually represented explicit content.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Interpreting the high-level features models learn; uncovering biases and measuring texture bias; identifying security vulnerabilities; advancing interpretability and robustness in machine learning.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset was synthetically generated using the Stable Diffusion text-to-image model from constructed descriptive prompts. Images flagged by the safety filter were regenerated to ensure a consistent number of images, and the final dataset was balanced across all 56 texture classes.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset underwent a three-stage refinement process consisting of filtering steps: (1) frequency filtering to remove object-like images by retaining only the top 80% of images with the highest frequency cutoff threshold, (2) patch variance filtering to eliminate homogeneous images by filtering out the bottom 20% of images with the lowest mean patch variance, and (3) CLIP score filtering to ensure prompt alignment by removing the bottom 20% of images with the lowest CLIP scores. Additionally, any images flagged by the Stable Diffusion NSFW safety filter were excluded.
